verdict: Yes, for a mission-driven hardware team. Annie by Thinkerbell Labs, a Braille literacy device, got a deal from three sharks on Shark Tank India Season 1. Schools for the visually impaired and government programmes need affordable tools, but sales go through institutions and CSR budgets rather than individual buyers.
angle: India has a large visually impaired population, and many children lack Braille teachers. Self-learning devices can help schools teach more students. Government programmes, NGOs and CSR funds are the main buyers, so plan for long sales cycles.
